sheets.title: CHEMICAL BUILDING — MECHANICAL DEMOLITION AND NEW WORK
sheets.reading_notes: Plan of chemical building showing demolition of existing HVAC equipment and new work. Key scope items: new roof-mounted exhaust fan EF-1 (Greenheck G-095-VG, 690 CFM, 0.5 ESP, 1/6 HP, 115V direct drive) serving chemical building; new motorized intake louver L-1 (20x20 inches, steel, in Room 106); two Class B/Div 2 hazardous-area designations visible on plan, relevant to explosion-proof equipment requirements. Exhaust fan-roof-centrifugal detail and louver-motorized detail shown. Floor elevation approximately 521.80±. Rooms labeled 104, 105, 106, 107. Date May 2023. Designer RAO, owner RAO, checker BB. Note: drawing title block shows 'Bowman Foster & Associates, Inc.' DBA/in association with Cornwell Engineering Group — BFA logo and address (712 Gum Rock Ct, Newport News VA 23606) confirmed on title block, confirming BFA as the engineer of record.

sheets.title: LEGEND AND ABBREVIATIONS
sheets.reading_notes: Electrical legend sheet. Defines construction note symbols, demolition note symbols, lighting and panel/switchboard schedule note symbols. Fixture schedule note references: fluorescent and LED lighting fixtures shown. Equipment symbols defined: duplex convenience receptacle (20A, 125VAC, NEMA 5-20R), exhaust fan connection, unit heater connection, motor connection HP as indicated, electrical panelboard (208Y/120V), disconnect switch, homeruns to panel (panel and circuit designations as indicated). Notably shows specification for explosion-proof LED luminaire LE551 (4-ft, 2-row, 64W, 4000K, 120-277/277-480V input, Class I Div 2 / Class II Div 2 rated; copper-free cast aluminum housing, borosilicate glass tubes, powder coat black). Reference note: 'NKWD has a separate project to install emergency generators' — confirms parallel generator replacement project ongoing at site. General note 13: Fort Thomas supply line to pumps 1, 2, and 5 shall not be disrupted during construction outages. May 2023. Designer MED, Owner LAW, Checker BAS.

sheets.title: CHEMICAL BUILDING — ELECTRICAL DEMOLITION
sheets.reading_notes: Electrical demolition plan for chemical building at scale 1/4"=1'-0". Scope of demolition: disconnect/remove multiple 1/2 HP polymer feed valve motors, filter aid polymer feed pumps (LPB-25, LPB-27, LPB-29, LPB-31), hybrid coagulant transfer pump (LPB-25), existing sump pump (1HP, LPD-33), carbon mixer (3/4HP, LPB-34), carbon screw feeder (1HP, LPB-32), PAC feeder pump (3/4HP, LPB-21), PAC feeder pump (3/4HP). Existing dust collector exhaust fans 1HP to remain. Existing unit heater/exhaust fan to remain. Remove existing filter and polymer control panel (salvage panels for owner). Remove existing polymer feed valve control panel. Remove existing mixer and polymer sump pump controller. Remove existing polymer mixer control panel. Remove existing lighting fixtures. Scale 1/4"=1'-0". Powdered activated carbon system area labeled. Class 1, Division 2 area in lower right of plan. Two rooms visible (104, 105, 107). Date May 2023. Designer BFF, Owner LAW, Checker BAS. Note: extensive demolition scope shows substantial replacement of existing chemical feed/PAC systems.

sheets.title: MAIN TREATMENT BUILDING — ELECTRICAL DEMOLITION (UV)
sheets.reading_notes: Electrical demolition plan for main treatment building at scale 1/8"=1'-0" focused on UV system. Shows finished water clearwells (4 sections), high service pump area (pumps #1, #2, #3), UV Train 1, UV Train 2 (24" CFE noted), electrical panels (LPB-1, LPB-2), air blower panel, LPHV, LPUV, XFLV panels, elevator, LP-1, PP-UPS. Floor elevation 510.17±. Demolition notes: remove UV system control panel (disconnect wiring extend to new controller on first floor); remove existing UV reactor 'A1' (existing wiring to remain for connection to new unit); disconnect/remove existing UV reactor 'A2' (remove all power and control wiring and conduit); remove existing UV UPS complete including all panels and battery bank in tunnel between buildings; existing control valve to remain (serving power circuit). Note that UV Train 2 label implies one train designated for removal, one being refurbished/replaced. NKWD has separate project for emergency generators/electrical service replacement running concurrently. Date May 2023. Designer B?? (partially legible), Owner /W, Checker BAS.
